description: A project work-breakdown tree in the Svelte 5 data grid: phase, task and subtask rows with owner, due date, status and percent complete. Leaf tasks carry a user-entered percent and every ancestor's percent is derived as the effort-weighted average of its descendants, so editing a subtask's percent recomputes the task and phase above it on commit. Editing is enabled for leaf rows only.

faq.question: How does the parent percent recompute?
faq.answer: onCellValueChange writes the leaf's new percent, then a $derived computes each ancestor's value as the sum of child percent times effort divided by the summed effort. The grid re-renders from the derived rows.

faq.question: How are parent rows kept read-only?
faq.answer: The percent column's editable function returns true only for leaf rows, so double-clicking a phase or task does nothing while a subtask opens the editor.

faq.question: Can I use this with the built-in treeData prop?
faq.answer: Yes. treeData handles the expander and indent; keep the roll-up logic in your own derived state exactly as here and pass the computed rows as data.
